text_block_list.text:
When I arrived full of enthusiasm at work 
in the morning, I was greeted by Hayakawa 
Tazuna, the secretary to the president.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, trainer. Your days with your 
horse girl are finally starting!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Working together towards strengthening 
body and mind, cultivating your bond… I 
hope you enjoy many fruitful days!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
If you perform well in a variety of races, 
you may eventually reach the pinnacle of 
racing; a G1 title!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm looking forward to it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
—To be frank, the first three years of the 
Twinkle Series are very important.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
If you fail to achieve a certain level of 
performance within three years of her 
debut—

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
This may result in the termination of your 
Uma Musume contract.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
That's why these three years are crucial! 
Please cooperate and get through this 
together.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
First up, you should start training for 
the upcoming "Make Debut".

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text: Well then, have a good day!
